description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class 'AbstractPolicyEvent' for policy-related events within a signaling framework, including common properties such as event type, policy ID, revision, timestamp, and headers, and providing methods for JSON serialization and equality checks.

classes.name: AbstractPolicyEvent
classes.description: An abstract class representing a policy event with common properties and serialization logic.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the event.

methods.name: getRevision
methods.description: Returns the revision number of the policy.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the event timestamp, if present.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing metadata; default is empty.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the headers associated with the event.

methods.name: getManifest
methods.description: Returns a string that represents the manifest of the event, defaulting to the event type.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the event to a JsonObject according to the provided schema version and predicate.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Abstract method to append event-specific data to the JSON payload.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for equality with another object.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper for equality checks, determines if another object can be considered equal.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code value for the object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the event.
